newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to auction $500 mln 2-yr Bontes Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to auction $500 mln 2-yr Bontes Feb 18.

text.p: Argentina will issue $500 million in two-year Bontes, or Treasury bonds, at its next auction on February 18, market sources said Thursday.

The bonds will be fungible, or exchangeable for the $500 million two-year Bontes auctioned at a yield of 8.0 percent in December, market players told Reuters after meetings with Economy Ministry officials.
Additionally, players said at next month's Letes Treasury bill sale, the government will auction 250 million pesos of 91-, and $500 million of 364-day bills.
Players said that the details of the next Bonte and Letes auctions were still subject to final approval from Economy Minister Roque Fernandez.
The Economy Ministry announced Thursday that it will auction 250 million pesos of 91-, and $250 million of 182-day day bills at this month's Letes auction on February 11.
